description: Public focus-trap primitive. Wraps arbitrary content, cycles Tab and Shift+Tab inside it, moves initial focus in on activation, restores focus on deactivation, and marks the background inert while modal. Only the innermost active scope handles Tab and only the topmost handles Escape. A canvas editor passes RestoreFocusTarget so focus returns to the canvas instead of the trigger.

parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: Whether the trap is active. An inactive scope renders its content without trapping.

parameters.name: Modal
parameters.description: Whether the scope is modal. A non-modal scope reports aria-modal false and leaves the background usable.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Content trapped while Active is true.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTarget
parameters.description: The element focus returns to on deactivation. Null restores whatever was focused when the scope opened.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the restore target, recorded on the root so a test and the module can both find it.

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.description: The id of the element that names the scope, wired to aria-labelledby.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: An accessible name for the scope, wired to aria-label.

parameters.name: DialogRole
parameters.description: The dialog role. A dangerous confirm passes alertdialog.

parameters.name: InitialFocusTarget
parameters.description: The element that receives focus on activation. Null focuses the first focusable.

parameters.name: InitialFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element that receives focus on activation.

parameters.name: InitialFocusSelector
parameters.description: A CSS selector resolved inside the scope for the element that receives focus on activation — e.g. the first [role='menuitem'] of a menu sheet. An explicit InitialFocusTarget or InitialFocusTargetId wins; without any of the three, focus falls back to the first focusable (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: CloseOnEscape
parameters.description: Close on Escape. The listener is document-level, so Escape closes the scope wherever focus sits.

parameters.name: OnEscape
parameters.description: Raised when Escape is pressed and CloseOnEscape is true.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes appended to the root.
